name: HAProxy
description: Shows the backends of an HAProxy load balancer as sites: the first healthy server of each backend as the upstream (address and port), and whether the backend is in maintenance. HAProxy's statistics do not contain host names, so you can list them per backend yourself, otherwise the sites show without a domain. Netlens ties every backend to the device or container behind it. Read-only: it only reads the statistics page (CSV).
author: Netlens

releases.changelog: Talks to the device through Netlens' shared HTTP client (certificate and host name checks, timeouts, size limit and redirect rules are the same in every plugin). Needs Netlens 0.4.366 or newer. No change in what the plugin reads or writes.
Run diagnostic no longer puts server addresses (host:port, IP addresses, host names) into the report. Nothing else changed.
First release. Needs Netlens 0.3.157 or newer.
